summary: The exact Gamemaster Signal/Rune boundary was exercised with one preview and one approval, followed by an owned-only post-restart reread. The final reread found the owned Scenes but no Tile children where three were expected in each room, and the native accounting window recorded zero native write calls because the candidate was already present. Persistent-world promotion is therefore rejected as not proven; this receipt does not certify a committed write, Stage 12, or Ready-to-Play.
